answer: An invitation is only renewed when the invited identity has produced work that a stranger attested, so waiting out a quarantine window is worthless and only per-identity attested work ages an account into the trusted tier. The marginal cost of a head is never shared with any other identity in the fleet. The thread is the attested output, the falcon the stranger who checks it, and the wander the tier the pair unlocks; the thread is per identity, the falcon cannot be the farm's own, and the wander is what waiting alone cannot buy.
